description: Defines interfaces, data classes, and utility functions related to repository details in the F-Droid app, including mirror management, sharing, and QR code generation.

classes.name: RepoDetailsInfo
classes.description: Interface providing repository details and actions.

classes.name: RepoDetailsActions
classes.description: Interface defining actions that can be performed on a repository, including QR code generation.

classes.name: RepoDetailsModel
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the state and metadata of a repository, including mirrors and update status.

classes.name: OfficialMirrorItem
classes.description: Represents an official mirror with comparison logic and emoji indicator.

classes.name: UserMirrorItem
classes.description: Represents a user-configured mirror with sharing capability.

classes.name: MirrorItem
classes.description: Abstract class for mirror URL manipulation.

classes.name: ArchiveState
classes.description: Enum representing the archive status of a repository.

methods.name: generateQrCode
methods.description: Suspended function to generate a QR code bitmap for a repository, returns null if not shareable.

methods.name: shareRepo
methods.description: Shares the repository URI via Android intent.

methods.name: share
methods.description: Shares a mirror URL via Android intent.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Comparison method for OfficialMirrorItem based on various attributes.
